_comment: Mirrors the Platform contract fixture `recovery-code-mint-throttled.v1.json` for the four recovery-code mint routes. A throttled mint is answered 429 with a Retry-After header in whole seconds, at least 1. The `error` value is prose and illustrative: never render it. Routes: mfaSetup = POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/setup; authRegenerate = POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate; enrollVerify = POST /api/v1/profile/security/mfa/enroll/verify; profileRegenerate = POST /api/v1/profile/security/recovery-codes/regenerate.

body.error: Recovery codes were generated moments ago. Wait before generating them again.

throttled._note: Retry-After is whole seconds, at least 1 (7 is an example). There is no retryAfter body field on this refusal; the `error` text is illustrative.
